semiconductor_relevance: Low — Emulsion Flow Technologies focuses on solvent-extraction technology for environmental applications rather than semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Emulsion Flow Technologies develops advanced solvent-extraction technology aimed at efficient resource recovery and environmental solutions. Their technology is particularly effective for PFAS removal, rare-metal recovery, and battery recycling, which may have indirect implications for the semiconductor industry in terms of materials sourcing and sustainability.

regional_presence.Japan: EFT has achieved significant results in Japan, including a demonstration project with over 99.9% PFAS removal.
